Hi all,

Draft proposal (technical):

Option A — Dedicated + Premium SLA (recommended)
- Baseline committed pool sized for 40 GPU-hours/day (equates to X gpus depending on model family).
- Burst buffer: autoscale policy to allow up to 2x baseline for 4 hours; queuing/backpressure controls to bound latency impact.
- p95 target: 200ms (with measured window at typical sequence lengths per CLB test set). We will provide a latency profile with 95th percentile computed over 5-minute buckets; credits trigger when p95 >= 200ms for two consecutive 10-minute windows.
- On-call: 24x7 escalation to Redwood on-call -> dedicated SE (Karthik) -> account owner (Naomi) -> engineering cadence. Response SLA: 15 min ack for P0, 60 min for P1.
- Data plane isolation: options for tenant-level encryption + audit logs.
- Implementation lead time: 4–6 weeks (includes capacity reservation + verification testing).

Estimated incremental cost (delta over current): ~$18k/month for baseline + burst reserve (ballpark, depends on exact GPU type and model mix). I can break this down by GPU SKU if procurement wants.

Option B — Hosted premium SLA (no dedicated GPUs)
- Lower cost, p95 SLO depends on pooled capacity and may require higher credit thresholds. Recommended only if strict isolation isn't required.

Attachments: CLB_dedicated_config.xlsx (capacity sizing + cost model).

Next steps: 1) Naomi to confirm preferred option, 2) legal to draft amendment with our SLO credit language, 3) procurement review -> sign.
